text:
Devon: Heads-up — we need a 1.14.2 hotfix for a kvcache regression. Targeting cutover in ~2h, aiming for a minimal-diff patch only. Please keep changes tiny.
Marta: Ack. Can you paste the changelog snippet + branch name so I can watch for other cherrypicks?
Devon: Changelog: ```- fix(kvcache): avoid index drift when sequence reset (regression introduced in 1.14.1)```\nBranch: `hotfix/1.14.2-minimal`
Alex: Ping release owners. No extras in this branch unless critical :+1:
release-bot: release-bot: Notifying release-oncall and ops. Canary window suggested: 30m. @ops please confirm rollback plan.
Sanjay: I can review the PR in ~15m. If CI is green I'll LGTM quickly. Any DB/migration concerns?
Devon: No migrations. ~8 LoC change in the runtime kvcache path. CI targets: unit, integration (linux/gpu). Build hash: `sha256:deadbeefcafebabefeedface`
Jen: QA: I'll queue a staging smoke once the PR is merged. ETA 30m for quick perf + regression smoke.
ops-bot: ops-bot: Deploy slot requested: 50 minutes from now (ts 2145804268). Strategy: rolling restart across 3 pods, canary 10% for 10m. Fallback route set to model-variant `small-cost` if latency spikes.
Alex: Reminder: cutoff for cherrypicks is ~30m from Devon's message. If you need to add something, ping here now.
Marta: Removed an unrelated lint tweak I saw in the branch, force-pushed `hotfix/1.14.2-minimal`. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1234
Sanjay: Reviewing now... looks clean. Running local unit patch + integration run. LGTM, adding :shipit:
Devon: merging now: `git checkout main && git fetch && git merge --ff hotfix/1.14.2-minimal` then tagging `1.14.2-hotfix`
release-bot: Deploy initiated. Command: ```deploy --env prod --tag 1.14.2-hotfix --strategy rolling```\nStarted canary on shard-1.
Jen: Staging smoke passed. KVCache perf test shows expected behavior, no regressions.
ops-bot: Canary passed after 10m. Rolling out to remaining pods now. Health checks green.
Alex: Nice. No postmortem unless we see recurrence. Thanks team :tada:
Devon: Thanks all — keeping this minimal saved us time. Closing the loop in the morning with a short changelog note and handoff to support.
_notes: Generated Slack thread for hotfix coordination; single-thread format, messages prefixed by sender. No title per agents.md.
